hook.evidence: Opens with 'Hey guys, welcome back to the channel! Today we are going to talk about something really interesting.' — greeting and channel context, no reason to stay.

structure.evidence: Facts drift ('Honey is made by bees. Bees are very important for the planet.') with filler beats and a CTA outro; between 1 and 3 because a thin payoff exists: 'So that's why honey doesn't go bad.'

clarity.evidence: Easy words but the mechanism is vague: 'This is because honey is special. It has a lot of sugar. Also bees add stuff to it.' — more than one step skipped ('stuff' is ambiguous), so below 3.

pace.evidence: 99 spoken words / 30 s = 3.30 wps, above the 3.2 ceiling but not over 180 or under 40; no visual cues marked; between 1 and 3.

accuracy.evidence: 'Scientists found honey in Egyptian tombs and it was still good' stated as fact with no source; no sourcing anywhere; between 1 and 3 because nothing is clearly wrong, only oversimplified ('It has a lot of sugar' as the reason).

voice.evidence: Generic YouTuber template: 'Pretty cool, right? Make sure to like and subscribe and comment your favourite food below. See you in the next video, bye!' — could be any channel.

notes: Pace counts spoken words only (brackets excluded, punctuation-only tokens excluded) over 30 s target.
